included: Етап 2. Прибери нульові метрики й порожні панелі

sharedBuildingBlocks.collectionChrome: apps/web/src/lib/collection-chrome.ts: collectionChrome({ baseTotal: number | undefined, hasQuery: boolean }) -> { showMetrics: boolean, showTools: boolean }. baseTotal comes from the filter-independent summary/overview query of the section (undefined while pending or on load error, so the existing skeleton / SummaryError UI keeps owning case 4). showMetrics = baseTotal !== 0. showTools = baseTotal !== 0 || hasQuery (reset path survives URL params). Every Stage 2 page task consumes it instead of a local boolean.
sharedBuildingBlocks.illustrationScale: One responsive scale in components/illustration.tsx driven by Tailwind breakpoints plus one new height variant in styles/globals.css (@custom-variant tall (@media (min-height: 50rem))). No arbitrary Tailwind values.
sharedBuildingBlocks.illustrationRatio: One grouped object keyed by EmptyStateIllustration giving the real intrinsic ratio (3:2 for the 7 wide PNGs, 1:1 otherwise) so next/image reserves the right box.
sharedBuildingBlocks.headerActionRule: When collectionChrome says base-empty and the empty state's primary runs the same handler as the header button, the header button is not rendered (pattern already used on Home: features/home/components/home-dashboard.tsx:102).
